items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Cronkite is talking about the Bulge, his memory of it, with me.

ctx.x: Private Brubeck Remembers. Cronkite is talking about the Bulge, his memory of it, with me. You can get that from George Moore at my house, because they only allowed 10,000 copies with that CD to be released. They’re all gone, but George has made a tape of it.
After the war, you decide to go to Mills College. What determined that decision? Why did you decide to go to Mills?
